changeSet.author: OGC
changeSet.comment: A result component's label can be translated, as a test's name is.

changeSet.author: OGC
changeSet.comment: Every existing result component gets an empty translation record; new ones get it when saved.
changeSet.sql: WITH missing AS ( SELECT id AS component_id, nextval('clinlims.localization_seq') AS localization_id FROM clinlims.test_result_component WHERE label_localization_id IS NULL), created AS ( INSERT INTO clinlims.localization (id, description, lastupdated) SELECT localization_id, 'result component label', now() FROM missing) UPDATE clinlims.test_result_component c SET label_localization_id = m.localization_id FROM missing m WHERE c.id = m.component_id;
